name: Shoot
description: Fire the equipped weapon.

name: Overwatch
description: Fire a reaction shot at the first enemy that moves in line of sight during the enemy phase.

name: Reload
description: Refill the clip.

name: Hunker Down
description: Double cover defense until your next turn. Needs cover.

name: Melee
description: Strike an adjacent target.

name: Run & Gun
description: May fire after a dash, once every 3 turns.

name: Close Combat
description: +20 crit within 4 tiles.

name: Lightning Reflexes
description: The first reaction shot against this unit each enemy phase misses.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Two shots at -15 aim each for 1 AP.

name: Hit & Run
description: A shot at a flanked target refunds 1 AP (once per turn).

name: Untouchable
description: After a kill, the next attack against this unit misses.

name: Killing Zone
description: Overwatch fires at every mover in LOS (max 3 shots).

name: Squadsight
description: Can target enemies visible to any squadmate.

name: Snap Shot
description: May fire after moving, at -20 aim.

name: Steady Aim
description: +15 aim on this soldier's first shot of each mission.

name: Sentinel
description: Reaction shots can crit.

name: Low Profile
description: Half cover counts as full.

name: In The Zone
description: Killing a flanked or uncovered target refunds the action (max 3 per turn).

name: Headshot
description: +3 damage.

name: Suppression
description: Costs 1 AP, ends the turn, uses 2 ammo. The target gets -30 aim, and if it moves it takes a reaction shot. Lasts until the next turn.

name: Shredder
description: Hits remove 1 armor permanently.

name: Bulletstorm
description: Firing doesn't end the turn if the soldier hasn't moved this turn.

name: Grenadier
description: +1 grenade charge and +1 grenade damage.

name: Danger Zone
description: +1 radius for suppression area and explosives.

name: Mayhem
description: +2 damage for suppression reaction shots and explosives.

name: Rupture
description: The next shot always crits and the target takes +3 damage from all sources for the rest of the mission.

name: Field Medic
description: +1 medkit charge; medkits can be used at range 1 (adjacent including diagonals).

name: Smoke Screen
description: +1 smoke grenade, and its radius is +1.

name: Revive
description: Medkits heal 2 extra HP and instantly revive a bleeding-out soldier to 1 HP.

name: Hack
description: Stun a robot within 6 tiles for 1 turn. Hack% = 50 + 5 x rankIndex - 15 x robotTier.

name: Sprinter
description: +3 mobility.

name: Savior
description: Medkits heal +4.

name: Overclock
description: Give an ally +1 AP this turn.

name: Overclock
description: +1 AP to an adjacent robot.

name: Double Shot
description: Takes 2 shots per turn; firing doesn't end the turn.
